## Body

**Where it lives.** Gate: `crates/daemon/src/cache_proxy.rs` (pure `precheck`/`decide`/`transition`, plus `CacheProxy` client and watch), called from `launch_seat_locked`, so spawn and revive both gate. Env goes in `build_spawn_plan` (`CopilotProviderWiring`, five `COPILOT_PROVIDER_*` incl. `VISION=true`). Seat state is `SeatDescriptor.cache_proxy` in `seats.cache_proxy` (migration 0047, JSON).

**A launch-stamped seat fact must follow the launch's process, not the row.** Review P2 (sporting-mouse): Copilot `/new` builds the successor with `SeatDescriptor::new` in `registration.rs`, so anything stamped only at spawn is lost. Also, `existing.cloned()` let a reclaim or an outside relaunch keep the dead row's stale stamp. Rule now in registration: keep it if `binds_spawned_incarnation` or the same proc re-registers. Otherwise take the verified same-process `predecessor`'s value, or None. Any new per-seat spawn fact needs the same rule.

**Watch rules (pm-004 rulings).** One loopback GET every 30 s, plus one immediately at start (a `start_validated_with_wake` wake that fires once). First read: silent if `ready` or no live proxied seat, else one notice. Later reads: one held FYI per state change to each distinct live prime (projects' `prime_id` plus the designated prime, deduped). `off` is "new spawns plain, existing unaffected", never worded as a failure. The status client uses `no_proxy()` and `redirect::Policy::none()`. Non-2xx means `Unreadable`, and the seat runs plain.

**Private rig that worked (real sidecar, test port).**
- `pij-rs cache-proxy --port 17571 --state-dir <tmp>`, then `pij-rs cache-proxy account <login> --port 17571 --state-dir <tmp>`. This uses its own config, so 7471 and the LaunchAgent stay untouched.
- Daemon: `PIJ_TMUX_SERVER=<name> PIJ_CACHE_PROXY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:17571 pij-rs daemon --bind 127.0.0.1:<port> --state-dir <tmp2>`.
- Set the private tmux server's global env: `PIJ_RS_ADDR`, `PIJ_RS_STATE_DIR`, and `-gu PIJ_SESSION_ID`. Without that, spawned seats register with the prod daemon.
- Spawn with `--session <s> --no-wait`. Read the env from `display -p '#{pane_start_command}'`. Read notices from `pij-rs --json state <prime> | .data.pendingFyis`. Make a prime with `PIJ_SESSION_ID=<seat> pij-rs orchestration prime set <seat>`.
- The sidecar's log shows `status=200`, `(from <-1m id>)` and the `1h=`/`5m=` writes. That is the cheapest row 22 receipt.

**Traps.**
- The shared target's `debug/pij-rs` is whichever lane linked last. Copy it out right after your build and check a flag only your branch has.
- Relative-path edits land in the main checkout (fourth strike, D-229-1). Use absolute worktree paths always.
- `ddocs set` writes 2-space JSON. Run `biome format --write` on the .dd.json, or `harness checks` lint fails.
- Workstream steps have no `delivered_by`. Put the PR in the step note.
- Running `harness checks` under `nice -n 19` fails `shared-build.test.ts` (niceness 20). Run it un-niced.
- `separate_adapters_cannot_both_reserve_one_pane` (pij-tmux) flakes under load 14+ and passes alone.

**Mutation receipts are cheap.** In eval: replace one guard line, run `shared-build -- test -p pij-daemon --lib <filter>`, restore in `finally`, then grep that the source is restored. 6 mutants took about 6 builds and closed mouse's static-mutation questions in one round (proof.md § Mutation receipts).
